text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After today's mini concert, Silence Suzuka speaks with a fan, searching for answers as to how concerts relate to her running.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her fan enjoys concerts because they present an opportunity to sing with her, resonate with her emotions, and "welcome her home."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While watching a race, fans want nothing more than to see their favorites back safe with them again—that's what prompts them to shout "welcome home!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Upon hearing this, Suzuka makes up her mind to listen more closely to the people cheering her on at her next concert.
